race.comment: BOOMROUX (9) couldn't make it six wins on the trot last time when well below his best here. Drops back to a trip he relishes and is drawn to advantage. Can bounce back sharply. INVICTUS LAD (10) has the recent consistency to keep him honest, with a close second at this venue two runs back and a strong record with Emma Bell, although he is still searching for a first win at the trip despite repeated placings. I'M ZAC (7) has been holding form well, was less than a length off BOOMROUX two back and brings useful track and distance credentials, but he has had several chances to convert. MAGICAL SLIPPER (4) was the eye-catcher among the dangers when third at this track last start after covering ground, and her track-and-trip record gives her a genuine winning platform if she repeats that run.
